basis: Forward project construction screens only. No TABULA school/office benchmarks, calibration, regulation or verified historical representativeness is implied. Range departures require review rather than automatic rejection. Contradictory declared physical boundaries remain errors.

provenance.rationale: Explicit engineering screening policy informed by the retained user period recipes: masonry early offices/schools, later timber-frame school walls, and concrete office walls/floors. Bounds deliberately allow multiple assemblies and omitted period variation; they are neither survey confidence intervals nor Swedish regulatory limits. Full material capacity screens check the declared construction family and units, not effective RC capacitance. Passing is not independent validation.

Broad family-specific project review screen: early masonry school/office walls, later timber-frame school walls and concrete office walls, with optional timber/concrete intermediate floors. The seven-era mapping spans older nine-bin source recipes. These are engineering review triggers, not fitted nominal values or source U benchmarks.
